findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jp_rules_changes · Private data: jp_invoice_consumption_tax, jp_stamp_duty, jp_era_convert · Public sink: x_post_weighted_length.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jp_rules_changes · Private data: jp_invoice_consumption_tax, jp_stamp_duty, jp_era_convert · Public sink: x_post_weighted_length

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
